clip_contract.compactness_rule: The exact copied source appears once. Other fields are bounded maps, range indexes, or local capture refs.
clip_contract.reader_index_rule: reader_index is mandatory and range-only; never treat it as a semantic summary or source authority.
clip_contract.command_ledger_rule: command_ledger preserves detected commands as pointers with bounded output excerpts and hashes; full output remains in the source range.
clip_contract.terminal_state_rule: terminal_state_index points to captured terminal-state evidence and must not override exact source authority or live re-verification.
clip_contract.edit_zero_claim_rule: edits=0 is window-local unless edit_claim.type_b_consumer_rule.unqualified_no_edits_allowed is true; downstream readers must say "no edits captured in this trace window" for selected or partial windows.
clip_contract.diff_state_rule: diff_state must say whether exact plus/minus substrate hunks are attached, missing, or intentionally summary-only for full_thread_concise.
clip_contract.prompt_capture_rule: Toolbar prompt captures use capture_context.capture_kind=prompt in the private packet and keep this same clip contract in the visible export.
clip_contract.operator_thread_export_rule: AIW thread exports use capture_context.capture_kind=operator_thread_export and may carry operator_tab_match metadata that binds copied text to HUD/CDP tab identity without trusting visual tab number alone.

status_semantics.not_detected: Parser did not find a signal in the captured source.
status_semantics.not_applicable: Signal is not expected for this artifact variant or capture shape.
status_semantics.unavailable: Signal requires an omitted/lossless source variant or live re-verification.
status_semantics.missing_required: Signal is required for promotion but absent from the captured evidence.

source_integrity.reconstruction_authority: Read the sibling raw sidecar file as exact source; source_segment_index provides byte and line ranges.

reader_index.purpose: Range-only start map; source text stays in source_segments or raw sidecar.

question_routes.question: What happened and what should I do next?
What passed, failed, or remains unverified?
What ran and what did it return?
What changed in the final substrate?
Which exact source supports the claims?
How did the controller and workers get here?
What is omitted or available only in a sidecar?

capsule_evidence.policy: Ranges are 1-based inclusive [start,end]. scope/section/section_refs index scopes/sections. Resolve refs within the same scope; body_ref names the canonical row. Exact source retains omitted index rows.

compaction_hints.source_partition: clip=bulk evidence; user text=salience/control unless SOURCE/facts
compaction_hints.specimen_vs_target: clip/compaction request => trace is specimen, not task to continue
compaction_hints.density_guard: default compact; expand only restart-changing distinctions
compaction_hints.section_gate: optional sections need restart delta; otherwise []
compaction_hints.example_guard: examples/prior answers are specimens unless labeled SOURCE
compaction_hints.schema_overfit_guard: smallest output shape; no prior-schema copying by default

reader_index.policy: Choose ranges to restore; do not copy index rows as source facts.

agent_episode_graph.graph_semantics: workflow phase presence; edge order is categorical, not chronology or parent-child identity
agent_episode_graph.agent_relationships: deployments listed where source metadata exists; no inferred identity links
agent_episode_graph.observed_scope_label_rule: Assembly labels show included scopes; they do not independently establish parent-child relationships.
agent_episode_graph.warning: This graph covers supplied source evidence only; original-session completeness and uncaptured relationships are unknown.

diff_state.reason: no edit evidence was captured in this selected/partial source window

operator_interventions.rule: Operator/user interruptions are lifecycle events and can revise plan, scope, or execution authority. Zero counts are scoped to the copied source window unless full_thread_count is numeric.

goal_pass_ledger.rule: Goal markers describe a pass ledger; they do not prove edit/no-edit state without diff and coverage evidence.

navigation_tutorial.index_filename_note: Commands use the supplied index filename.

local_capture.note: The exact supplied source is in the sibling raw sidecar; this JSON contains indexes.

pattern_catalog.source_purpose: Deterministic, non-authoritative motifs mined from the copied text so long captures can be browsed before exact source reading.
pattern_catalog.policy: Pattern families are dynamic. This manifest includes counts, row shapes, and bounded samples; the private full packet keeps complete pattern rows.

source_segment_index.reconstruction_rule: Use byte_range_utf8 against raw_sidecar to inspect a segment, or read the raw sidecar end to end to recover the exact copied clip.
source_segment_index.line_break_policy: Segment text preserves the original line endings from the copied source.

reader_contract.rule: Copied content appears once in the sibling raw sidecar. This JSON contains bounded indexes only.
reader_contract.no_edit_claim_rule: Do not say "no edits were made" unless edit_claim.type_b_consumer_rule.unqualified_no_edits_allowed is true. For selected/latest windows, say only that no edits were captured in that window.
reader_contract.exact_text_request: Read raw_sidecar.filename next to this index JSON; local full packet keeps duplicate full projections.
reader_contract.continuation_selection_rule: Use indexes to choose evidence for semantic carryforward or restart state; do not expand all source ranges unless terminal or semantic state remains ambiguous.

omission_receipt.reason: Single JSON would exceed the measured size budget because JSON string escaping bloats the source. The exact clip is stored once in a sibling raw sidecar; this JSON is the bounded index.

raw_sidecar.reconstruction_rule: Use the sibling raw sidecar file as the exact copied source; this JSON only indexes it.

size_policy.target: lossless export, source once, <= source + 25% plus fixed allowance when JSON carrier is feasible
